title: [SBW] Drone Warfare
description: SBW Drone Warfare expands Superb Warfare with tactical FPV drones, LUCAS UAVs, fiber links, radar, etc...
body:
![drone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b7ca90e7420c6d4ea9c2c830e75708d952036a5_0.webp)

**New in 1.0.2!**
![jammer tower](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5fe4b9b93284345ffcc89fdd079b63e080f6330f.png)

**Rader jammer tower requires solar power but jammes drones in 1200 blocks!**

![stack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccbeabb1326daecc99b02efa5c9342f0a88eb178.png)

**You can now stack all items of SBW!**




# 🚁 SBW Drone Warfare

Transforms Superb Warfare drones into a complete tactical drone system with FPV flight, fixed-wing UAVs, electronic warfare, fuel logistics, and anti-drone defense.

**🎯 Want to make Superb Warfare even more realistic?**

Add **[[SBW] Advanced CIWS](https://modrinth.com/mod/sbw-advanced-ciws)** and protect your bases against incoming aircraft, missiles, drones, and other aerial threats.

🛡️ Advanced Air Defense
🚀 Smart Target Tracking
⚙️ Fully Configurable
🎯 Built for Superb Warfare


---

## ✨ Features

### 🚁 FPV Drone

* FPV-style flight and camera
* Wireless and Fiber Optic control
* Drone inventory & modules
* Spotlight support
* Weather camera effects
* Drone screenshots
* Configurable engine audio
* Jammer support
* Anti-drone net support

![fpv](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d656ef46736620c6ebcec7a48c6707b6f59b32eb.png)

### ✈️ LUCAS Drone

* Fixed-wing UAV flight
* Assisted takeoff
* Military UAV HUD
* Gasoline fuel system
* Louder aircraft audio
* Larger crash explosions
* Fiber Optic support
* Spotlight support
* Counter-drone system support

![lucas](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75ac29374a653f1dcc54fe6db80fb6394597ce6f.png)

---

## 📦 Drone Modules

* 🔦 Spotlight Module
* 🧵 Fiber Optic Spool Upgrade
* 🔋 Battery Support
* ⚙️ Drone Inventory System

---

## 📡 Electronic Warfare

### 📻 Drone Jammer Block

* Progressive jamming
* Signal disruption
* Configurable range
* Trusted player whitelist

### 📡 Drone Radar / RF Detector

* Detect nearby drones
* Compact radar HUD
* Directional tracking
* Signal strength display
* Distance readout
* Proximity beeping

### 🚨 Drone Detection Siren

* Detect hostile drones
* Alarm system
* Redstone output
* Whitelist support

---

## 🕸️ Anti-Drone Defense

* Anti-Drone Net
* Anti-Drone Net Carpet
* Anti-Drone Net Panel
* Fiber cable cutting
* Drone trapping and disruption

![drone nets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9b2d4be24154f832c68d7a67f9a3a1cd0df0901.png)

---

## 🧵 Fiber Optic System

* Physical cable-based control
* Resistant to normal radio jamming
* Configurable cable length
* Cable tension & snapping
* Damageable cable segments
* Recoverable cable remains

![fiber optic 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1cbf0a1bfeebefcf94ab54d07696a900113b91f.png)

![fiber optic 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2264ac1b02718706d07d4c6fcc5f54aa7273397.png)

---

## ⛽ Fuel System

* Fuel Mixer
* Gasoline Canister
* Empty Jerrycan
* Gasoline Jerrycan
* Ground refueling
* Fuel consumption
* Low fuel warnings

---

## 📦 Logistics

### 📦 Extraction Crate

* Land drones on crate
* Automatically extract inventory
* Collect items later

---

## 🔦 Spotlight System

* Tactical searchlight
* Real light projection
* Energy consumption
* Night mission support

---

## 🌡️ Thermal & Camera Systems

* Thermal Vision
* Weather camera effects
* Rain droplets
* Storm interference
* Camera tilt
* FPV vibration
* Wider FOV
* Signal breakup effects

---

## 📸 Drone Screenshots

* Dedicated screenshot keybind
* Save FPV images
* Optional shutter sound

---

## 🔊 Immersive Audio

* FPV engine sounds
* LUCAS engine sounds
* Radar beeps
* Fuel Mixer audio
* Monitor hum
* Distance explosions
* Audio config sliders

---

## ⚙️ In-Game Config GUI

Fully configurable:

🚁 Drone
✈️ LUCAS Flight
⛽ Fuel
🔋 Battery
📡 Jammer
🌦️ Weather
🔦 Spotlight
